The Shiba Inu wasn't just a meme — it became an emotional totem.

You can't fake that kind of symbol. You design for it or you get forgotten.

There was no elite Discord. No whitelist. No founders begging for hype.

Just a simple idea:
“If you like memes, you're already one of us.”
